title: Titanium Pedal Cleat Screw
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this pedal hardware application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by shoe cleat fixing screw set and fat life requirements.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for pedal hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g with SPC sampling
Go/No-Go ring gauging with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for shoe cleat fixing application
commonFailures: Fatigue failure at head tube junction - mitigated by smooth weld radius >=5mm + post-weld shot peening — critical for shoe cleat fixing performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Pedal Cleat Screw suitable for Shoe cleat fixing screw set?
faq.a: Titanium Pedal Cleat Screw uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address pedal hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Pedal Cleat Screw?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Pedal Cleat Screw is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for shoe cleat fixing requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Pedal Cleat Screw require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. shoe cleat fixing components require Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for shoe cleat fixing application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Pedal Cleat Screw shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Pedal Cleat Screw includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet shoe cleat fixing specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
